mineedge.config.title: MineEdge Settings
mineedge.config.description: Cosmetic first-person effects. Strength 0 disables an effect; 1 uses its full strength. Native view bobbing and pose height remain controlled by Minecraft.
mineedge.config.camera_effects.tooltip: Enable MineEdge's cosmetic first-person camera effects. Disabling clears all effects immediately. Movement and local sounds keep working.
mineedge.config.camera_roll.tooltip: Allow wallrun, slide, movement lean, head bob and parkour camera tilt. Disabling removes all MineEdge roll immediately without changing gameplay aiming.
mineedge.config.roll_strength.tooltip: Scale all camera tilt, including wallruns, slides, lean and parkour feedback, from 0 to 1.
mineedge.config.speed_fov.tooltip: Add up to 10 degrees at full sprint and 4 during wallruns. Composes with Minecraft's FOV; 0 disables.
mineedge.config.landing_strength.tooltip: Scale landing dip, pitch kick and hard-landing FOV decrease (up to 10 degrees), from 0 to 1. Does not change your aim or body position.
mineedge.config.shake_strength.tooltip: Optional sprint, slide and impact shake, from 0 to 1. Disabled by default.
mineedge.config.sway_strength.tooltip: Direction-aware body inertia for acceleration, braking, strafing and airborne motion, from 0 to 1. Default: 0.6; 0 disables.
mineedge.config.bob_strength.tooltip: Additional distance-driven footfall bob with soft compression and recovery. Fades when stopping or leaving the ground. Default: 0.5; 0 disables. Respects Minecraft View Bobbing.
mineedge.config.parkour_strength.tooltip: Smooth parkour posture and spring-based feedback for jumps, vaults, mantles, slides, rolls, turns, climbs and grabs, from 0 to 1. Default: 0.7; 0 disables. Landing feedback has its own control.
Animate climbing, sliding and wall-running player poses. Disable to let another animation mod control the player model. Movement physics keep working.
mineedge.config.server.editable: Server-owned rules for all players. Saving applies them live and persists them on the server.
mineedge.config.server.read_only: Current server rules (read-only). Editing requires operator permission level 2 or higher.
mineedge.config.server.unavailable: Load a singleplayer world or connect to a server to view and edit its movement rules.
mineedge.config.server.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for predicted, server-authoritative locomotion, sliding, vaulting and mantling in the enabled game modes.
mineedge.config.server.survival.tooltip: Enable MineEdge movement in Survival while the master switch is on. Enabled by default.
mineedge.config.server.adventure.tooltip: Enable MineEdge movement in Adventure while the master switch is on. Enabled by default.
mineedge.config.server.creative.tooltip: Enable MineEdge movement in Creative while the master switch is on. Disabled by default. Flying still uses vanilla movement.
mineedge.config.server.sliding.tooltip: Enable crouch-triggered, landing and steep-slope slides. Enabled by default.
mineedge.config.server.wall_running.tool: Enable running along walls. Enabled by default. Wall climbing and ledge hanging are independent actions.
mineedge.config.server.vaulting.tooltip: Enable vaulting over obstacles and springboards. Enabled by default.
mineedge.config.server.mantling.tooltip: Enable mantling onto obstacles and pulling up from ledges. Enabled by default.
mineedge.config.server.pipe_climbing.too: Enable grabbing, climbing and circling tagged pipes. Enabled by default. Ladder climbing is independent.
mineedge.config.server.door_push.tooltip: Automatically open closed wooden doors when sprinting forward into them on the ground. Enabled by default. Iron doors still require redstone.
mineedge.config.server.hard_landing.tool: Enable recovery after large falls. Hard landings decrease FOV and allow half-speed walking, without sprinting or jumping, for 1.8 seconds. Enabled by default.
mineedge.config.server.run_speed_multipl: Running top speed relative to walking speed, before Minecraft movement attributes. Range: 1–5×. Default: 1.8× (7.2 blocks/s at walking speed 4). Scales the sprint acceleration curve.
mineedge.config.server.walk_speed.toolti: Baseline walking speed before Minecraft movement attributes. Range: 0–20 blocks per second.
mineedge.config.server.jump_speed.toolti: Baseline jump speed before Minecraft jump power modifiers. Range: 0–20 blocks per second.
mineedge.config.server.gravity.tooltip: Baseline downward acceleration before Minecraft gravity attributes. Range: 0–100 blocks per second squared.
mineedge.config.server.fall_damage_multi: Scale fall damage during MineEdge movement. Range: 0–10×. Default: 1×; 0 disables damage. Composes with the slide/roll multiplier and vanilla block, attribute and enchantment modifiers.
mineedge.config.server.roll_damage_multi: Additional fall damage multiplier for a correctly timed landing roll. Range: 0–1×. Default: 0.5× (half damage); 0 prevents damage and 1 applies full base damage. Ordinary slides do not arm a landing roll. Vanilla block and enchantment modifiers still apply.
mineedge.config.server.minimum_fall_heig: Baseline safe fall height before fall damage begins. Range: 0–256 blocks. Default: 4 blocks. Minecraft safe-fall attribute and Jump Boost modifiers still apply. Damage is based on the height beyond this threshold.
mineedge.config.server.saved: MineEdge server movement settings saved and applied.
mineedge.config.server.denied: You need operator permission level 2 or higher to change MineEdge server settings.
mineedge.config.server.invalid: Movement settings must be finite numbers within the allowed ranges.
mineedge.config.server.save_failed: MineEdge could not save the server settings. The previous values were restored.
